description: This file implements an in-process TPM (Trusted Platform Module) simulation, including communication handling, TPM state management, and interaction with TPM commands. It defines classes, methods, and functions to simulate TPM behavior for testing or development purposes within the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: InProcessTpm::Impl
classes.description: Internal implementation class for the in-process TPM simulation, managing command queue, TPM state, and interaction with the underlying TPM simulation functions.

methods.name: FromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the Impl instance associated with a given TSS2_TCTI_CONTEXT.

methods.name: Transmit
methods.description: Handles transmission of TPM commands by queuing them.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Handles reception of TPM responses, processing queued commands and interacting with the TPM simulation.

methods.name: Impl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TPM simulation, including TPM state reset and context setup.

methods.name: ~Impl
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up TPM state and signals.

methods.name: TctiContext
methods.description: Returns the TCTI context for communication with the TPM simulation.
